description: Ministry of Defence - Order made to declare a period of time for firearms without licence to be handed over to the Government from the date of 30.05.2016 to 17.06.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the declaration of a legal/regulatory measure under the Firearms Ordinance, specifying a time period for surrendering unlicensed firearms and providing immunity from prosecution for those who comply. It cites specific legal authorities (Ordinances and Acts) and establishes regulatory requirements, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
